notes:
Remote ID no longer blocks the launch.

The Here 4 Blue's Remote ID module wedges at cold boot and reports "invalid
location" until it frees itself, a minute or two later. The autopilot was
willing to arm through it — the app was not, and that was the app's mistake.
LAUNCH now answers to the aircraft's own pre-arm check.

The RID readout says "Glitch" instead of the module's clipped error text. The
full wording is still in the status panel.

Spaces in a mission name become underscores, as you type. The name becomes a
folder on the drone, and a space there causes trouble downstream.

FLY is now DRONE, and the ARMED pill no longer reads "TAP TO DISARM" — it still
disarms, behind the same two confirmations.
